# ClippingStars

> ClippingStars is a short-form video clipping agency that converts long-form content into viral clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. With a global team of 150+ editors across four time zones, ClippingStars has generated more than 4.6 billion views for YouTubers, podcasters, and content creators.

## What ClippingStars does

- **Service:** Done-for-you short-form clipping, editing, captioning, content strategy, and posting. Clients provide long-form content; ClippingStars handles distribution end to end.
- **Platforms:** TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts.
- **Team:** 150+ editors, clippers, and strategists across four time zones (US, UK, Australia, UAE), posting from real local devices — no VPNs or fake accounts.
- **Proven results:** 4.6B+ total views; 184M YouTube views in 6 months on a single channel; 88.8M Instagram views in 90 days; a 17.3M-view TikTok clip; 2B+ views for Iman Gadzhi; 1.5B+ for Ayehxncho.
- **Engagement model:** Month-to-month, no long-term contracts. Application-based onboarding (Apply → Strategy Call → We Take Over → You Go Viral).
